tools.name: check_window_sticker
tools.description: Use this when the user has a 17-character VIN and wants the window sticker (Monroney label), build sheet, factory options list, packages, original MSRP, trim, engine, recalls or paint code for that vehicle, for example to check a used car or a listing's claims. Works for any make sold new in the US.

tools.name: get_original_sticker
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the contents of the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) for a 17-character VIN, such as the options list, packages or MSRP when new: total MSRP, base price, destination charge, every factory option and package with its price, exterior and interior color, eng

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_original_sticker" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_window_sticker" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
